title: Ellison Onizuka Kona International Airport at Keahole.
bodyText: The official name of the airport situated at Keahole in Kona, Hawaii shall be the Ellison Onizuka Kona International Airport at Keahole.
bodyHtml: §261-26  Ellison Onizuka Kona International Airport at Keahole.  The official name of the airport situated at Keahole in Kona, Hawaii shall be the Ellison Onizuka Kona International Airport at Keahole. [L 1993, c 53, §1; am L 1997, c 122, §1; am L 2016, c 256, §1]
